All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary of our position:

**Deviations redlined (7):**
- **LOL-CAP** (critical) — one-way cap protecting TrueLink only; Client's liability unlimited. Added a mirrored Client cap plus mutual consequential-damages exclusion, without reopening the scope of TrueLink's cap.
- **INDEMN** (critical) — TrueLink indemnifies only for its own breach; no IP-infringement, breach-of-law, data-incident or gross negligence prongs. Added them.
- **IP** (critical) — Section 8(d) lets TrueLink distribute, license, resell and exploit borrower Credit Data. Narrowed to service provision and confirmed our retained rights.
- **WARRANTY** — only Y2K warranties survive a broad disclaimer. Inserted workmanlike/90-day conformance warranty with repair-or-refund remedy.
- **ASSIGN** — affiliate carve-out only; no M&A/successor carve-out or reasonableness standard. Added both plus a no-change-of-control-trigger sentence.
- **LICENSE** — grant runs to Client alone with affiliates excluded. Added affiliates and contractors.
- **TRANSITION** / **INSURANCE** (missing) — no data return/transition assistance and no insurance covenant for a vendor hosting our site and handling credit data. Inserted both.

**Compliant (10):** NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, MFN (runs in our favour), NOSOLICIT, T4C (Client may exit on ~30–60 days, no vendor convenience right), RENEWAL (12-month terms, 30-day window), GOVLAW (California law and courts — fallback), AUDIT (no audit right against us), LD, MINCOMMIT (monthly floor terminable without penalty; blank amounts flagged for the commercial team).
